name: Alexandra Sutherland
title: Counsellor & Sex Therapist, Director
practice: Inclusive Therapy – Sex and Relationship Counselling
description: Individual and couples counselling and sex therapy in Brunswick. 'We welcome sex workers, LGBTIQA+ folk and marginalised communities. All practitioners are trauma-informed, gender-affirming, poly and kink-friendly.' PACFA Certified Practicing Counsellor with a Masters of Science in Medicine (HIV, STIs and Sexual health); passionate about sexual health, mental health and peer work. Services include trauma work and sex therapy; telehealth across Australia.
specialties: sex therapy, sexual health, trauma work, LGBTIQA+, gender-affirming, kink-friendly, poly-friendly, sex workers, couples
identity: 'She is queer and has a lived experience of accessing the supports she provides.'

name: Sabrina Brient
title: Clinical Psychologist - Children, Young People and Adults
description: Creates a safe and affirming environment where clients of all ages feel able to unmask. Services include LGBTIQA++ support, gender questioning (support, not gender-affirming reports), attachment or relational trauma, sexuality and intimacy, and neurodivergence (Autistic and ADHDer support). Based in Brunswick, Melbourne / Naarm in a disability accessible, neurodivergent friendly, inclusive clinic.
specialties: LGBTIQA+, gender questioning, relational trauma, sexuality and intimacy, neurodivergence, chronic pain/illness, children and young people

name: Amanda Cotta
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Clinical Psychologist working with adolescents, adults, couples and groups; sensitively explores early formative years and their impact on current functioning. Person-centred, emotion-focused approach using Mindfulness, Compassion Based Psychotherapy, IPT, Psychodynamic Therapy and CBT. 'Amanda is also trained in EMDR therapy.' Gottman Level 2 couple training. High St Northcote (Mon/Thu); Westgarth St (Tue).

name: Alison Horder
title: Registered Psychologist
description: Registered Psychologist working with anxiety, depression, self-esteem, assertiveness, coping, and developmental and relational trauma. High St Northcote (Mon, Thu, Fri).
specialties: developmental trauma, relational trauma, anxiety, depression

name: Cait Barr
title: Psychologist
description: Holistic and relational approach drawing from psychodynamic and other evidence-based modalities. 'Sensitive to the needs of diverse groups (LGBTQI+ affirmative).' Works with young adults on anxiety, depression, working through the impacts of trauma, identity and self-esteem, disordered eating, BPD and grief. Westgarth St, Northcote. (Also practises at Q Psychology Carlton.)
specialties: LGBTQI+ affirmative, trauma, identity, disordered eating, BPD, psychodynamic

name: Chaille Perrett
title: Registered Psychologist
description: Works with younger children to older adults on depression, anxiety, grief and loss, relationship difficulties and autism. Uses CBT, Schema Therapy, Interpersonal Therapy (IPT) and Narrative therapy, with interest in ACT and Emotion-Focused Therapy.
specialties: schema therapy, CBT, IPT, narrative therapy, autism

name: Freya Green
title: Registered Psychologist
description: Works with children (9+), adolescents and adults, drawing primarily on ACT alongside CBT. 'She works in gender-affirming and neuroaffirming ways and is particularly passionate about supporting young people, families and youth.' Also provides cognitive, educational and ADHD assessments.
specialties: gender-affirming, neuroaffirming, ACT, ADHD assessment, young people

name: Dr James van Cuylenburg
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Doctor of Clinical Psychology with over 15 years of experience with clients of all ages. Areas of interest include Trauma/Schema Therapy, narrative therapy, self compassion therapy, ACT, grief counselling and couples/family therapy. Westgarth St (Mon/Wed/Thu); Telehealth (Tue all day, Mon-Thu after 4pm).
specialties: trauma, schema therapy, narrative therapy, ACT, couples/family therapy

name: Katherine Lee
title: Registered Psychologist
description: Works with people aged 10+ on anxiety and low mood, stress and adjustment, trauma, OCD and attention/impulse difficulties. Draws on CBT, ACT, and approaches from DBT and schema therapy; 'It is important to her that therapy is trauma informed, culturally sensitive, and strengths based.'
specialties: trauma, schema therapy, OCD, DBT, ACT

name: Mitchell Stroicz
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Clinical Psychologist working mainly with adults 18+. Draws on CBT, ACT and Motivational Interviewing; experienced with depression, anxiety, ADHD, ASD, adjustment, grief and loss, Trauma (including PTSD) and OCD.
specialties: trauma, PTSD, ADHD, autism, OCD, anxiety

name: Paul Golod
title: Registered Psychologist
description: Registered psychologist who has assisted clients with anxiety, depression and trauma, working within CBT and Psychodynamic modalities with a person-centred approach.

name: Sallyann Kempler
title: Registered Psychologist
description: Over 20 years' experience across trauma, sexual assault and/or family violence, self-harm and more. Long career in Sexual Assault and Family Violence services with specialised skills in addressing sexual assault, family violence and children who demonstrate sexualised behaviours. Trauma informed; has facilitated trauma groups incl. a psychodynamic group for women managing impacts of trauma. Uses EFT, exposure therapy, mindfulness and CBT.
specialties: trauma, sexual assault, family violence, EFT, trauma groups

name: Sara Zakarija
title: Psychologist
description: Works with adolescents and adults; passionate about working with people from diverse backgrounds and communities. Draws on ACT, Schema Therapy, Mindfulness and elements of Psychodynamic Psychotherapy; most recently supported young people with experiences of trauma and homelessness.
specialties: schema therapy, trauma, ACT, psychodynamic, young people

name: Sally Blight
title: Psychologist
description: Experienced psychologist (100% Telehealth) working with adults, adolescents and children using CBT and mindfulness. Extensive experience with anxiety, depression, trauma, grief, serious mental illness, drug and alcohol.
